title: Build teacher worksheet discovery front end
goal: Turn the static prototype into a teacher-first worksheet library front end with exact-grade discovery, search, format selection, and broad K-12 math worksheet coverage.
context: The repo is currently a static HTML/CSS/JS math generator lab. Teachers should be able to quickly choose an exact grade, search by skill, click a worksheet type, choose from useful worksheet formats, and preview printable/digital worksheet instances generated from deterministic math logic.
acceptance: Teachers can filter worksheet types by exact grade from Pre-K/K through grade 12
Search and grade/type filters work together without removing the current printable worksheet preview
Clicking a worksheet type exposes multiple worksheet format choices and regenerates the preview in the chosen format
Worksheet inventory includes at least 90 generator entries across K-12 math
The static app still runs by opening index.html without an install step
Generator verification passes for every worksheet type
notes: Do not add accounts, auth, payments, databases, LMS integrations, PDF generation, or npm dependencies. Keep worksheet generation deterministic and self-checkable.
